title: Tenth Pylon
summary: Begun under Amenhotep III and completed under Horemheb, the gateway joined successive royal projects.
orientation: Southernmost of the ten numbered pylons, on the route toward Mut and Luxor.

claims.text: Begun under Amenhotep III and completed under Horemheb, the gateway joined successive royal projects.
Its upper towers incorporated talatat from dismantled Aten buildings.
An eastern doorway connected its court with administrative, storage and priestly areas. Ritual circulation was embedded in a working institution.

caveats: Field access and demonstration viewpoints are unverified; this is an editorial research draft.
